extrapolation_safeguards.monotherapy_to_synergy_extrapolation: BLOCKED: Monotherapy efficacy is never cited as evidence that combination CI < 1.0 pre-exists.
extrapolation_safeguards.in_vitro_to_in_vivo_extrapolation: BLOCKED: In vitro findings on A549 are strictly flagged with preclinical boundary warnings; no human clinical efficacy is asserted.
extrapolation_safeguards.derivative_to_parent_extrapolation: BLOCKED: Synthetic lupeol derivative data (Deng 2024, Tian 2024) are classified as STRUCTURAL_ANALOGUE_EVIDENCE and not conflated with pure natural Lupeol.
extrapolation_safeguards.unrelated_agent_extrapolation: BLOCKED: Compounds such as arjunolic acid, betulin, or crude plant extracts are quarantined from Lupeol evidence records.
